content:
Rumored for some time, Apple is developing a brand-new all-glass iPhone to mark its 20th anniversary next year. However, analysts at Wells Fargo Securities believe that the device is no longer moving forward.

Wall Street analysts claim that the bold redesign plan for the 20th anniversary edition iPhone has been cancelled.

Wall Street firm Wells Fargo Securities downgraded Apple's stock rating to "Underperform" today. Analyst Edison Lee pointed out that a potential cancellation of the 20th anniversary iPhone redesign is one of the main reasons.

The key to this downgrade lies in the suspected cancellation of Apple's all-glass iPhone. Although reports of the project under development emerged as early as 2025, with rumors suggesting a launch as early as 2027, Apple has never commented on these speculations. However, Apple quietly filed a patent for a "six-sided glass enclosure" back in 2019. Wells Fargo Securities had previously considered an all-glass iPhone launch a reasonable assumption, but Lee believes development work has come to a halt. According to the analyst, supply chain checks indicate that the project was scrapped due to excessively low yield rates. Lee considers this decision "a major setback for driving higher-priced iPhones amid soaring memory costs." If the device launches as scheduled in September 2027 to commemorate the 20th anniversary of the iPhone, its estimated blended retail price would reach US$2,060, higher than any previous model's average selling price. Lee wrote: "More importantly, we believe the original plan was to extend the all-glass design to future iPhone Pro and Pro Max models, further boosting their average selling prices and gross margins." He believes that against the backdrop of rising memory prices, this should have been a crucial defensive move.

Lee also pointed out that Apple's AI strategy and rising component costs for the iPhone 19 Pro are additional reasons for the further downgrade of its stock rating.

From Lee's report, it is unclear whether the analyst believes the entire redesign plan has been shelved or only certain aspects have been cancelled.

The most upvoted comment was posted by Currentinterest.

These analysts have missed the mark countless times when predicting Apple's future plans. Even the term "all glass" may never have accurately captured what Apple truly intends to do. The 20th anniversary edition phone will be innovative and will be highly sought after regardless of its final configuration.

For example, there have long been speculations that Apple will not be able to completely remove the Dynamic Island cutout next year. Therefore, an "all glass" display will be impossible. However, the rumored quad-curved design may still be in progress.

Regardless, if Apple's iPhone 20th anniversary design has indeed been cancelled, we should receive confirmation from other authoritative sources very soon.

What are your thoughts on this report regarding the iPhone 20th anniversary design? Feel free to let us know in the comments section.
